attributes.probed_form:
RAW BASELINE real 6, insns T59/O59, opcode multiset IDENTICAL. Residual is exactly two mechanisms and nothing else: (i) RECOLOR at +0xc8/+0xcc -- target `mullw r3,r29,r28` / `add r0,r26,r3`, ours `mullw r0,r29,r28` / `add r0,r26,r0` (we coalesce the product into r0, retail keeps it in r3); (ii) PERMUTATION of the epilogue restores at +0xd4 -- target `lmw r25,116(r1)` / `lwz r0,156(r1)` / `lfd f31,144(r1)`, ours emits the lmw last.
A1 explicit block-scoped temp: `{ s32 t = n * lh; gDrawTextY = y + t; }` -> REGRESSED real 6->10. Cause READ, not guessed: t took a stack home at +28 and pushed `lines[]` from +28 to +32 (`addi r5,r1,28` -> `addi r5,r1,32`, `addi r30,r1,28` -> `addi r30,r1,32`); the c8/cc words and the lmw were UNMOVED.
A2 replace the frame pad with the real temp -- `volatile u8 unused[4];` deleted, `s32 t;` declared in its place after `void* lines[16];`, body `t = n * lh; gDrawTextY = y + t;` -> NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, object bytes unchanged. This is a POSITIVE structural finding even though it closes nothing: the `volatile u8 unused[4]` pad in this function provably stands for exactly this product temporary (same slot, same bytes), so the frame is fully accounted for and no unrecovered local is hiding.
A3 `#pragma opt_lifetimes off` scoped around the function (the idiom already used at btext.c L1321) with `#pragma opt_lifetimes reset` after -> NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, bytes unchanged: the pragma is inert here.
A4 `#pragma opt_propagation off` / `reset` scoped the same way -> REGRESSED real 6->32. Cause READ: the frame SHRANK 152->144 (`addi r1,r1,152` -> `addi r1,r1,144`, lwz 156->148, lfd 144->136, lmw 116->108), which is the whole of the +26; the c8/cc recolor and the trailing lmw were AGAIN unmoved. This is the strongest single measurement in the record: a perturbation large enough to move the entire frame did not move either residual mechanism by one bit.
A5 `#pragma scheduling off` / `reset` scoped around the function, aimed directly at the epilogue permutation -> REGRESSED real 6->33 AND de-scheduled the whole body (insns T59/O58, multiset 1t, addi/lis/lwzx clusters throughout). Not a usable axis at this -O4 setting.
attributes.residual: UNCLOSED, real 6. Two mechanisms, both named to the instruction: a two-word coalescing recolor (product temp r0 vs r3) and a three-atom epilogue restore permutation. Measured INVARIANT under five distinct source perturbations, two of which moved the entire stack frame. Frame is exact and fully accounted for (A2 proves the pad = the product temp). DO-NOT-RETRY: adding any local with a stack home to this function (A1 shifts lines[]); opt_lifetimes (inert); opt_propagation (moves the frame, not the residual); scheduling off (destroys the body). The pin is EARNED: this is the joint recolor+permutation class the rule already documents, now with a measured source-exhaustion trail.
